courses.title: Microeconomics I
courses.description: First half of the microeconomic theory sequence required of all Rice Economics PhD students covering traditional consumer theory, producer theory and general equilibrium.

courses.title: Market Design
courses.description: Upper level undergraduate elective targeted at economics major. It studies the design and use of market-based mechanisms to solve problems of economic resource allocation.

courses.title: Microeconomics II
courses.description: Second half of the microeconomic theory sequence required of all Rice Economics PhD students covering game theory, information economics and mechanism design. Co-taught with Hulya Eraslan.
